contributions.detail: Form A (p2) carries NO rows and a large hand-drawn 'N/A' written in blue across the middle of the grid -- the filer marking the whole schedule as not applicable, i.e. an EMPTY SCHEDULE (an honest zero), not a row and not a zero-valued transaction. The printed footer TOTAL cell was left BLANK by the filer (verified at 600 dpi -- the cell holds only the printed '$' and the rule), so schedule_total is "" (field exists, blank), NOT null and NOT 0. Cover line 1 is a slashed-zero glyph in ALL THREE columns (Zero-glyph ruling: = 0), so the scopes coincide -- recorded cumulative. Line 2 (<=$50 aggregate) is likewise a slashed zero in all three columns and is never itemized.

expenditures.detail: Form B (p3) carries NO rows and the same large hand-drawn 'N/A' across the grid -- an EMPTY SCHEDULE. Its printed footer TOTAL cell is also blank. The empty schedule matches cover line 3's THIS REPORT cell (a slashed zero = 0) and NOT the cumulative cell (527.00, carried from the prior report), so this schedule is PER-PERIOD -- a different scope from the CUMULATIVE figure this module publishes, and reconciles_expend should be left blank rather than scored a failure. Cover arithmetic checks: 527.00 + 0 = 527.00.

gates.page_subtotal: Both schedules print a footer TOTAL and the filer left BOTH blank, so no page-subtotal gate could fire; gated against the cover instead. p2: 0 rows = cover line 1 (slashed zero in all three columns). p3: 0 rows = cover line 3 THIS (slashed zero). Nothing failed to gate.

The mark crosses several ruled bands but is a single continuous stroke pair, not row content; it was NOT transcribed as a row.
gates.geometry_proof: Not applicable -- zero rows were emitted on either side, so there is no row geometry to prove. For the record, the 'N/A' mark sits at roughly pct:38,29,17,9@p2 and pct:38,30,14,9@p3 and is not a data row.
gates.balance_chain: Closes exactly, twice over. (a) Contributions cum 0 - expenses cum 527.00 = -527.00 = cover line 4 CUMULATIVE, written '(527.00)' -- accounting parentheses, i.e. negative. (b) The columns also chain: line 4 LAST '(527.00)' + THIS (slashed zero = 0) = CUM '(527.00)'. No earlier filing by this filer in this chunk, so no cross-filing chain test was possible.
